g.text: SD01 Manage vehicle profile and saved sessions (F01, F10; UC01, UC10)
Create or edit a profile (F01), then auto-save (F10)
[a saved session for the same vehicle exists]
Every later "publish(...)" in SD02-SD08 is delivered
the same way: GUI and CLI refresh, AutoSaveListener saves.
Load a saved session from the CLI (F10)
